channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alex Rodriguez | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alex Rodriguez from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ryan Tanke on Alex Rodriguez, Marc Lore
item.description:
“To reinvent the organization, it had to be bold. I don’t know that you can find bolder or more transformational than Marc Lore and Alex Rodriguez and that became a really great jumping-off point for the rest of the week.”

Ryan Tanke on Alex Rodriguez, Marc Lore, Aug 5, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Alex Rodriguez
item.description:
Dane Moore:Anthony Edwards on his feelings about Alex Rodriguez being the Timberwolves new owner:

“I don't know who that is. I know he's going to be the owner. But I don't know anything about baseball.”

Anthony Edwards on Alex Rodriguez, Apr 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Alex Rodriguez
item.description:
“I just say to him, 'You're Alex Rodriguez. You're A-Rod. You're one of the best to ever do it,'”

Kobe Bryant on Alex Rodriguez, Oct 17, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.
